verses.text: ለእስራኤል የነገሠ የዳዊት ልጅ የሰሎሞን ምሳሌዎች፤
ጥበብንና ተግሣጽን ለማወቅ፥
የቃልን መልስ ለመቀበል
ብልሃትን ለየውሃን ይሰጥ ዘንድ
ጠቢብ እነዚህን በመስማት ጥበብን ይጨምራል፥
ምሳሌንና የተሸሸገውን ነገር፥
የጥበብ መጀመሪያ እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ነው፤
ልጄ ሆይ፥ የአባትህን ምክር ስማ፥
ለራስህ የክብር ዘውድን
ልጄ ሆይ፥ ዝንጉዎች ሰዎች አያስቱህ፤
“ና ከእኛ ጋር ደምን በማፍሰስ አንድ ሁን፥
በሕይወት ሳለ እንደ ሲኦል እንዋጠው፥
ብዙ ሀብቱን እንሰብስብ፥
ዕጣህን ከእኛ ጋር ጣል፤
ልጄ ሆይ፥ ከእነርሱ ጋር በመንገድ አትሂድ፥
እግሮቻቸው ወደ ክፋት ይሮጣሉና፥
And they shall not be consumed in vain by the fowl,
Those who do not seek to devour shall bring destruction upon themselves.
This is the way of all who commit sin.
ጥበብ በጎዳና ትመሰገናለች፤
በግንብ ድምድማት ትሰብካለች፥
“ይህን ያህል ዘመን የዋሃን ጽድቅን ሲከተሉ አያፍሩም።
እነሆ፥ የቃሌን መንፈስ እነግራችኋለሁ፤
በጠራሁ ጊዜ አልሰማችሁኝምና
“ምክሬን ሁሉ ናቃችሁ፥
ስለዚህ እኔ በጥፋታችሁ እሥቃለሁ፤
ጭቅጭቅ ድንገት በመጣባችሁ ጊዜ፥
ግን በጠራችሁኝ ጊዜ እኔ አልሰማችሁም፤
ዕውቀትን ጠልተዋልና፥
ምክሬን ይመለከቱ ዘንድ አልፈቀዱምና፥
ስለዚህ የሥራቸውን ፍሬ ይበላሉ፥
አላዋቂዎችን አለመመለሳቸው ትገድላቸዋለችና፥
የሚሰማኝ ግን በተስፋ ይኖራል፥

sections.title: A blessing that is found in wisdom.

verses.text: ልጄ ሆይ፥ ቃሌን ብትቀበል፥
ጆሮህ ጥበብን ትሰማለች፥
ጥበብን ብትጠራት፥ ቃልህንም ለማስተዋል ብትሰጥ፥
እርስዋንም እንደ ብር ብትፈልጋት፥
የዚያን ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ታውቃለህ፥
እግዚአብሔር ጥበብን ይሰጣልና፤
እርሱ ቅንነትን ለሚያደርጉ ደኅንነትን ያከማቻል፤
የጽድቅን ጎዳና ይጠብቃል፤
የዚያን ጊዜ ጽድቅንና ፍርድን ታውቃለህ፤
ጥበብ ወደ ልብህ በመጣች ጊዜ፥
መልካም ምክር ትጠብቅሃለች፤
አንተን ከክፉ መንገድ፥
እነርሱ በጨለማ መንገድ ይሄዱ ዘንድ
ክፉ በመሥራት ደስ ለሚላቸው
መንገዳቸው ጐጻጕጽ፥
ከቀናች መንገድ እንዳያርቁህ፥
ልጄ ሆይ፥ ቃሌን ጠብቅ፥
ቤቷን በሞት አጠገብ አኖረች፥
ወደ እርስዋ የሚገቡ ሁሉ አይመለሱም፥
ቀና መንገዶችን ቢሄዱ
The righteous shall dwell upon the earth,
The paths of the wicked shall be destroyed from the earth;

sections.title: The counsel of a father for his children.

verses.text: My son! Do not forsake my laws,
for many days and long life,
let not your heart forsake wisdom and understanding;
for in humility shall you find your strength,
trust in the Lord with all your heart,
and in all your ways acknowledge Him;
do not be wise in your own eyes;
this shall be health to your flesh,
honor the Lord with your substance and with the firstfruits of all your increase.
your barns shall be filled with plenty, and your vats shall overflow with new wine.
ልጄ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ተግሣጽ ቸል አትበል፥
አባት የሚወድደውን ልጁን እንደሚገሥጽ
ጥበብን የሚያገኝ፥
በወርቅና በብር፥ በብዙም መዛግብት
ዋጋው ብዙ ከሆነ ዕንቍም የከበረች ናት።
ረጅም ዕድሜና የሕይወት ዘመን በቀኝዋ ነው።
መንገዶችዋ መልካም መንገዶች ናቸው።
እርስዋ ለሚመረኰዛት ሁሉ የሕይወት ዛፍ ናት፥
እግዚአብሔር በጥበብ ምድርን መሠረተ፥
በዕውቀቱ ቀላያት መነጩ፥
My child, do not be afraid.
Your soul shall be at rest.
In all your ways, you shall walk in peace.
When you sit down, do not be afraid;
for there shall be no evil thing that shall come upon you.
For the Lord shall dwell in all your paths;
Do not be afraid to do good for the one who is in need;
When you have the opportunity to do good,
He shall be with you, resting beside you;
For there is no evil that He has created against you.
Do not bring forth a bribe from the wicked.
Every sinner is an abomination unto the Lord;
The dwelling of the Lord is in the house of the wicked;
The Lord shall cast out the proud;
The wise shall inherit honor;

sections.title: The benefit that is found in wisdom.

verses.text: ልጆች ሆይ፥ የአባትን ተግሣጽ ስሙ፥
መልካም ስጦታን እሰጣችኋለሁና፥
እኔም አባቴን የምሰማ ልጅ ነበርሁና፥
ያስተምሩኝም ነበር፥ እንዲህም ይሉኝ ነበር፦
የአፌንም ቃል ቸል አትበል።
አትተዋት፥ ትደግፍህማለች፤
ጥበብ ዓይነተኛ ነገር ናትና ጥበብን አግኝ፤
ጠብቃት፥ እርስዋም ከፍ ከፍ ታደርግሃለች፤
ለራስህ የሞገስ አክሊልን ትሰጥሃለች፥
ልጄ ሆይ፥ ስማ፥ ንግግሬንም ተቀበል፤
የጥበብን መንገዶች አስተምርሃለሁና፤
ብትሄድ ፍለጋህ አይጠፋም፤
ምክሬን ያዝ፥ አትተውም፤
በክፉዎች መንገድ አትሂድ፥
በተጓዙበትም ቦታ አትሂድ፤
ክፉ ካላደረጉ አይተኙምና፥
የኀጢአት መብልን ይበላሉ፥
የጻድቃን መንገዶች ግን እንደ ብርሃን ይበራሉ።
የኃጥኣን መንገዶች ግን ጨለማ ናቸው።
ልጄ ሆይ፥ ንግግሬን አድምጥ፤
Let not your sources be disturbed,
For those who seek them shall find life,
Keep your heart with all diligence,
Turn away from a wicked mouth,
Let your eyes look straight ahead,
Make straight paths for your feet,
Do not turn to the right or to the left;
ልጄ ሆይ፥ ጥበቤን ተመልከት፤
መልካም ዐሳብን ትጠብቅ ዘንድ
ከአመንዝራ ሴት ከንፈር ማር ይንጠባጠባልና፥
ፍጻሜው ግን እንደ ሐሞት የመረረ ነው፥
እግሮችዋም ወደ ስንፍና ይወርዳሉ፥
በሕይወት መንገድም አትሄድም።
አሁንም ልጄ ሆይ፥ ስማኝ፥
መንገድህን ከእርስዋ አርቅ፥
ሕይወትህን ለሌላ እንዳትሰጥ፥
ባዕዳን በሀብትህ እንዳይጠግቡ፥
Thy body, when it is weary, shall afterward be refreshed.
Thus dost thou say: "How have I pursued instruction!"
And I have not heeded the words of my teachers,
in the midst of the congregation and the assembly.
Drink water from thine own cistern, and from the well of thy own spring.
Let not thy waters flow forth into the streets.
Let them be for thee alone,
and let thy well be for thee.
In love and in tenderness,
My son, do not associate with a strange woman.
The way of man is before the eyes of the Lord,
Sin doth ensnare a man,
He shall die with the wicked;
ልጄ ሆይ፥ ለወዳጅህ ዋስ ብትሆን፥
የሰው ከንፈሩ ጽኑ ወጥመድ ነው፤
ልጄ ሆይ፥ እኔ የማዝዝህን አድርግ፤ ራስህንም አድን፤
ለዐይንህ እንቅልፍን፥ ለሽፋሽፍቶችህም ሸለብታን አትስጥ፤
እንደ ሚዳቋ ከወጥመድ፥
አንተ ታካች፥ ወደ ገብረ ጕንዳን ሂድ፥
ጌታ ሳይኖረው፥ መሰማርያ ሳይኖረው፥ የሚያሠራውም ሳይኖረው፥
መብሉን በበጋ ይሰበስባል፥
አንተ ታካች እስከ መቼ ትተኛለህ?
ጥቂት ትተኛለህ፥ ጥቂትም ትቀመጣለህ፥
እንግዲህ ድህነት እንደ ክፉ መልእክተኛ፥
ዓመፀኛና ሰነፍ የሆነ ሰው
በዐይኑ ይጠቅሳል፥ በእግሩ ይናገራል፥
ጠማማ ልቡ ሁልጊዜ ክፋትን ያስባል፤
ስለዚህ የማይድን ውድቀትና መመታት፥ ጥፋትም ድንገት ይደርስበታል፤
እግዚአብሔር የሚጠላቸው ስድስት ናቸው፥
ትዕቢተኛ ዐይን፥ ሐሰተኛ ምላስ፥
ክፉ ዐሳብን የሚያበቅል ልብ፥
ሐሰተኛ ምስክርን የሚያቀጣጥል፥

sections.title: As it is fitting for one to be removed from death.

verses.text: ልጄ ሆይ፥ የአባትህን ሕጎች ጠብቅ፥
ሁልጊዜ በልብህ አኑረው፥
ስትሄድም ይመራሃል፤
ትእዛዝ መብራት፥ ሕግም ብርሃን ነውና፥
ከጐልማሳ ሚስት፥
ውበቷ ድል አይንሣህ።
የአመንዝራ ሴት ክብር እስከ አንዲት እንጀራ ነው፤
በጕያው እሳትን የሚታቀፍ፥
ወይም በፍም ላይ የሚሄድ፥
ወደ ጐልማሳ ሚስት የሚገባም እንዲሁ ነው፤
A thief who is caught shall not be spared,
Even if he be caught, he shall repay sevenfold,
But he who is devoid of understanding shall suffer,
He shall encounter disgrace and dishonor,
For he is filled with deceit and wrath,
A guardian shall not be moved by anything.
My son, keep my words,
My son, honor the Lord, and you shall be preserved.
With your hands, I shall work them;
Wisdom said: "You are my sister,"
from the wicked and from the evil woman.

sections.title: Concerning the woman of the Ammonites, do not approach her.

verses.text: In the house, she is as a window, and she looks towards the entrance;
Among the young men who are not known, when she sees the one who is poor in knowledge,
as she walks along the path that is near her house, while she speaks;
when evening comes, and there is a decline;
a woman who causes the hearts of the young men to be ensnared by her beauty;
she is a seducer and a deceiver;
at one time in the street, and at another time at the entrance;
whether she has caught him or not;
"It is the offering of my love;
therefore I have come to entice you."
Upon my bed, I shall meditate upon thee,
In my slumber, I shall remember thee and reflect upon thee.
Yea, until I awaken, I shall seek thee with love.
For my Lord is not in his house,
And in his hand is a golden scepter;
In many games, she shall be made to rejoice;
He shall follow with his neck bowed down,
And as the wolf is drawn to the prey,
My son, now therefore, hear me,
Let not thy heart be turned away from her path;
She has caused many to stumble;
Her house leads down to death.
Teach thou wisdom,
She is upon the heights of the mountains,
She shall keep watch over the mighty gates,
O ye people, I shall proclaim unto you,
O ye who are wise, consider wisdom;
I shall speak of that which is beloved; hearken unto me,
For she shall teach thee truth,
All the words of my mouth are truth;
In the presence of those who know, she is all that is right,
Better than silver is instruction,

The Lord prepared me for the work, establishing the beginning of my path.
Before the earth was formed, He created me in the presence of the world.

When the clouds were thickened above,

The source of life is in the mouth of the righteous,
Anger stirs up strife.
A wise man draws forth wisdom from his lips;
The prudent conceals knowledge;
The wealth of the diligent is a fortified city;
The work of the righteous brings forth life;
The path of life is preserved by diligence;
The lips of the wise conceal knowledge;
The multitude of words leads not to sin;
The answer of the righteous is like a refined silver.
The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable;
The blessing of the Lord rests upon the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
A slothful man does not roast his game, but the diligent man prizes his possessions.
The wicked shall return to destruction;
The wicked shall vanish like the chaff before the wind.
As a thorn goes up into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
The fear of the Lord prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
Joy is with the righteous;
The fear of the Lord is a stronghold to the upright,
The righteous shall never be removed.

The balance of the river is a weighty matter in the sight of the Lord;
Where pride abounds, there is a fall;
The righteous shall be guided by their integrity;
On the day of wrath, money shall not avail;
The way of the perfect man shall be made straight;
The righteous shall be protected by their integrity;
A righteous man, when he dies, shall not lose his hope;
The righteous shall be delivered from trouble;
In the mouth of the wicked is a snare for the nation;
In the faithfulness of the righteous, the city shall be exalted;
The city of blessings is exalted in its lamentations;
Wisdom shall awaken the man who has been ensnared by his country.
A man who is two-faced shall reveal the secret of the assembly;
A teacher who lacks others shall be cast down like a leaf.
The wicked man shall be punished when he mingles with the righteous;
A faithful woman shall bring honor to her husband;
A good man shall do well for his own soul;
The wicked man shall perform the work of evil;
A righteous child shall be born for life;
The crooked path is an abomination before the Lord.
A hand that strikes with deceit shall not be struck down;
As a golden crown is upon the head of the righteous,
The desire of the righteous is good;
They are those who sing of their own, and they shall be exalted;
The body that is blessed shall be revered by all;
He who feeds the grain shall be cast out among the nations.
He who thinks of good shall be loved for his good honor.
The man who trusts in his own strength shall fall;
A man who knows not his house shall inherit the wind;
From the fruit of the righteous shall spring forth the tree of life.
Behold, if the righteous be scarcely saved upon the earth,

He who corrupts the earth shall partake of bread;
The desire of the wicked is death.
A sinful man shall fall into destruction by his own mouth;
The soul of man shall partake of good things from his lips,
The way of the wicked is as darkness before them;
The wicked speaks his wrath daily;
A righteous man shall teach the revealed truth;
Those who conspire in falsehood shall be slain by the sword;
The lips of the righteous shall bear witness to the truth;
It is evil to meditate on wickedness in the heart.
The righteous shall not find joy in any evil thing;
A false witness is a great abomination before the Lord;
A wise man is a seat of understanding;
The chosen ones shall swiftly be gathered;
The words that cause joy are those of a righteous man, and they shall comfort his heart;
He who knows himself is righteous for himself;
The humble man shall not be troubled;
In the way of righteousness, there is life;
A wise son heeds the instruction of his father;
A righteous man shall eat of the fruit of goodness;
He who guards his mouth preserves his soul;
All that does not labor shall dwell in desire.
The righteous shall reject the words of falsehood;
Their path shall be kept by the righteous who is as a shining light;
There are those who, having nothing, act as if they are wealthy;
The wealth of a man is his soul;
For the righteous, there is always light;
A wicked man shall work iniquity with the deceitful.
Wealth gained through sin and deceit shall perish,
It is better for one who is humble and hopeful to begin to help his own body.
He who opposes the work of the Lord, the Lord shall oppose him.
The law of the wise is a fountain of life.
Good knowledge shall grant wisdom and understanding.
The wise shall work in all knowledge.
A deceitful messenger shall fall into evil.
Instruction shall deliver from poverty and shame.
The desires of the diligent shall preserve the soul.
He who walks with the wise shall be wise.

There is a way that seemeth right unto men;
Sorrow shall not dwell with joy;
The proud heart shall be brought low by its own path.
He believeth in all that is vain;
A wise man shall flee from evil;
The fool, without counsel, shall work folly;

The wicked shall be brought low before the righteous;

A true witness delivers the soul from evil;

The answer of the prudent is known to be good;
The eyes of the Lord are in every place;
The mouth of the righteous is a tree of life;
A foolish son bringeth shame to his father;
In the houses of the righteous is much strength;
The lips of the wise are preserved in knowledge;

The teaching of the wise shall be known among those who pass by.

A man of understanding does not delight in folly,
A heart that rejoices brightens the countenance;

He who hears the counsel of the wise

The wise are called discerning,
A good thought is a source of life for one who seeks to do good;
The heart of the wise is known by his mouth,
A gracious word is like honeycomb;
There is a path that seems right to a man;
A man in his distress will be burdened for himself,
A foolish man will bring calamity upon himself,
A slothful man will sow destruction,
An evil man will betray his friends,
With a piercing eye, he who is slothful will consider the matter.
A good name is a precious crown of glory,
The righteous man is stronger than the mighty,
The wicked man returns to his own wickedness in all things.
ብዙ ደስታ ከሞላበትና ከክርክር ጋር የዐመፃ ፍሪዳ ካለበት ቤት ይልቅ፥
ብልህ አገልጋይ አላዋቂዎች ጌቶችን ይገዛል፥
ብርና ወርቅ በከውር እንዲፈተን፥
ክፉ ሰው ከሕግ ውጭ የሆኑትን ሰዎች አንደበት ይሰማል፤
በድሃ የሚያላግጥ ፈጣሪውን ያነሣሣዋል፥
የሽማግሌዎች አክሊል የልጅ ልጆች ናቸው፤
የታመነች ከንፈር ለሰነፍ፥
ትምህርት ገንዘብ ለሚያደርጓት የባለሟልነት ዋጋ ናት፥
በደሉን የሚሰውር ሰው ዕርቅን ይሻል፤
ትምክሕት የአስተዋይ ሰው ልቡናን ያሳዝነዋል፥
ክፉ ሰው ሁሉ ጠብን ያነሣሣል፤
ዐዋቂ ሰው በትካዜ ውስጥ ይወድቃል፥
በመልካም ፋንታ ክፉን የሚመልስ፥

ለአላዋቂ ሰው ገንዘብ ለምንድን ነው?
ሁልጊዜ ወዳጅ ይኑርህ፥
አላዋቂ ሰው አጋና ይመታል፥
ክርክርን የሚወድድ በጠብ ደስ ይለዋል።
ጠማማ ልብ ያለው መልካም ነገርን አያገኝም፥
A heart that is greedy for wealth is a heart of sorrow;
A joyful heart shall find joy in laughter;
The paths that lead to wisdom shall not be hindered by the fool;
The wise man is known before his face;
A foolish son is a grief to his father;
To lead a righteous man astray is not good.
A wise man is one who refrains from speaking ill;
If a fool seeks wisdom, wisdom shall become his.
He who desires to separate from his friends seeks a reason.
The poor in knowledge do not cherish wisdom.
When the sinner approaches destruction, he is warned.
A word concealed in the heart of a wise man is like water stored up.
To turn one's face away from the wicked is not good.
The mouth of the unwise leads to evil.
The mouth of the unwise is a destruction to himself.
Fear drives away the timid.
He who does not attend to his work is lost.
The name of the Lord is a great power.
The wealth of the man of substance is as a fortified city;
Before destruction, the heart of man is haughty;
He who answers a matter before he hears it,
A wise servant shall appease his lord's wrath;
The heart of the wise shall acquire knowledge;
Wealth maketh a man high;
The righteous is he who humbleth himself before judgment;
He shall discern the strife;
A brother who helps his brother is as a fortified city;
A man shall be filled with the fruit of his mouth;
Death and life are in the power of the tongue;
He who finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor from the Lord.
Better is one who is not known than one who is deceitful.
It is not good for a soul to lack knowledge.
The way of man is led astray by his own desires.
A deceitful friend will multiply many companions.
A false witness will not go unpunished.
Many people serve before rulers.
He who oppresses the poor, his own brother, is a wicked man.
He who gains wisdom loves his own soul.
A deceitful witness will not escape punishment.
It is not fitting for the unlearned to be in authority.

የንጉሥ ቍጣ እንደ አንበሳ ግሣት ነው፥
አላዋቂ ልጅ ለአባቱ ኀፍረት ነው፥
አባቶች ለልጆቻቸው ቤትንና ሀብትን ያወርሳሉ፤
ችግረኛን ሰው ሽብር ይይዘዋል፥

ለድሃ ቸርነትን የሚያደርግ ለእግዚአብሔር ያበድራል፥
ለተስፋ ይሆንህ ዘንድ ልጅህን ግረፍ፥
ዐሳበ ክፉ ሰው ብዙ ያጠፋል፤

In the heart of man are many thoughts;
The fruit of man is the fruit of his labor;
To fear the Lord is the essence of man's life;
A humble man shall hide his hand in his garment;
If you provoke the wise, he shall become a fool;
He who dishonors his father and brings shame upon his mother;
A son who disregards the teaching of his father shall be rebuked;
The judgment that is given to the foolish child shall be a warning;
For the wicked, the path of destruction is prepared for them;
ለተሳዳቢና ለሰካራም ወይን ክፉ ነው፥

የሰው ክብሩ ከስድብ መከልከል ነው፤
ታካች ሰው ሲያሽሟጥጡት አያፍርም፤

The way of the righteous is like the dawn.
He who has an ear to hear and an eye to see,
Do not be deceived; do not despise the humble.
The one who sells says, "It is evil, it is evil."
Gold and much crimson are found therein;
Let him take off his garment from the one who does not know.
The bread of deceit is sweet to a man, but afterward his mouth shall be filled with gravel.
A wise heart will heed counsel;
The one who bears a burden will reveal the secret;
The light that honors father and mother shall be extinguished.
አስቀድሞ ለርስት የሚቸኩል፥
ጠላቴን እበቀለዋለሁ አትበል፤
ሁለት ዓይነት ሚዛን በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ አስጸያፊ ነው፥
የሰው አካሄዱ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ይቃናል፤
ሰው ከገንዘቡ በችኮላ የተቀደሰ ነው ብሎ ቢሳል፥
ብልህ ንጉሥ የኃጥኣን መንሽ ነው፥
የሰው መንፈስ የሆድን መዛግብት የሚመረምር፥
ቸርነትና እውነት ንጉሥን ይጠብቁታል፤
ለጐልማሶች ጌጣቸው ጥበብ ነው።

The heart of the king is like water in the hand of the Lord;
Every man is seen as righteous in his own eyes;
To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice.
To have a heart that does not become haughty is great wisdom.
The thoughts of the wicked lead to violence;
A false witness will perish, but he who listens will speak endlessly.
Those who do righteousness will not be forsaken;
The Lord will grant the desires of the thirsty;
It is better to dwell in a corner of a housetop than in a house shared with a contentious woman;
The soul of the wicked shall not be acquitted, even if it is for one man.
When a wicked man falls, a wise man shall understand his downfall;
The heart of the wicked knows not righteousness,
A man who hardens his ear that he may not hear the cry of the poor,
A gift given in secret stirs up anger,
To execute judgment is joy to the righteous;
A man who strays from the path of righteousness,
He who loves joy shall be poor,
The wicked is cast down before the righteous,
Better is it to dwell in a corner of the housetop than with a contentious woman in a wide house.
A cherished record is brought forth by the mouth of the wise.
He who follows righteousness and mercy
The wise shall be honored in the city of the diligent,
He who guards his mouth and his answer
The name of the slanderer, the deceitful, and the false witness is accursed,
Our desires shall be fulfilled,
The wicked man daily longs for evil desires,
The sacrifices of the wicked are an abomination before the Lord,
A false witness shall perish;
The wicked man shall be confronted face to face without restraint;
Wisdom and strength, counsel also,
ፈረስ ለጦርነት ቀን ይዘጋጃል፤
A good name is better than great riches,
The rich and the poor meet together;
A wise man will not be chastised by a wicked man when he is strong;
To fear the Lord,
The way of the slothful is as a hedge of thorns;
Train up a child in the way he should go;
The poor will serve the rich;
He who sows deceit shall reap calamity;
He who oppresses the poor shall eat;
Cast out the scoffer, and contention will go out; yes, strife and reproach will cease.
The Lord shall delight in the heart of man.
The eyes of the Lord keep knowledge;
A humble man shall be favored in his time of need,
The mouth of the wicked is a deep pit;
The heart of the ignorant is lifted up high;
The poor man who is content shall have much,
To hear, incline your ear to the words of the wise,
If you keep them in your heart,
Let your hope be in the Lord,
For knowledge and counsel, behold, I have written three things for you.

Their protector, the Lord, is strong;
Give your heart to understanding;
Do not be cruel to the little ones;
You shall strike them with your rod;
My child, let your heart be wise;
If your words dwell in your lips;
Let not your heart be drawn to the wicked;
If you keep them, they shall be your reward;
My child, listen, and be wise;
Do not let wine be your companion;
And the wicked shall be cast away,
My son, hearken unto the voice of thy father,
Buy the truth, and sell it not,
A righteous father shall greatly rejoice in his son,
Thy father and thy mother shall be glad in thee,
My son, give me thine heart,
A woman of wisdom is a crown of glory,
And he that hasteth to her shall be consumed,
My son, to whom is the wailing?
Is not wine a mocker to those who partake of it?

And He shall protect those who are destined for death;
Behold, if you say, "I do not know this,"
My son, eat honey,
Likewise, let wisdom be learned in your body,
Do not lead the wicked to the place of the righteous;
The righteous may fall seven times, yet they shall rise again seven times.
Do not rejoice when your enemy falls,
For the Lord shall see it, and it shall not please Him;
Do not rejoice in those who commit iniquity,
For their time shall not be for the wicked.
My son, fear the Lord and the king,
for they shall swiftly punish the transgressors;
he who keeps their words shall be far from destruction,
it is not said that anything false shall be spoken in the presence of the king,
the word of the king is like a sword,
though the sword may be sheathed, it shall still destroy a man along with the wicked;
until he becomes one who does not consume the flesh of the wicked,
My son, fear my word, receive it, and enter into wisdom;
for I am more foolish than any man,
O Lord, grant me wisdom and teach me.
Who has ascended to heaven, and who has descended?
The word of the Lord is altogether true;
That you may not be deceived, and that you may not be a liar.
I will instruct you in two matters;
Keep far from me vanity and falsehood;
I earnestly pray that I may not be a liar:
Do not withhold your servant from the hand of his Lord;
A wicked son brings shame to his father;
A wicked son will destroy his own righteousness;
A wicked generation has haughty eyes.
The poor shall be delivered from the earth, and the oppressed from among men.
Know ye that it is good not to show favor to the face of man in the time of judgment.
The wicked shall say, "Thou art righteous."
Yet those who are cast out shall be made to see.
A word that returns in a matter shall be pleasing to the ear.
Prepare thy work for thy path.
Do not be a false witness against thy neighbor.
As I have done unto thee, so will I do unto them.
I have passed through the field of a slothful man.
Behold, the vine is withered, and the fig tree is barren.

እነርሱም ሲኦልና የሴት ፍቅር፥
በአባቱ የሚሥቅ፥
ላውቃቸው የማልችል ሦስት ናቸው፥
እነርሱም የሚበርር ንስር ዱካ፥
ሠርታ የምትታጠብ፦
በሦስት ነገር ምድር ትናወጣለች፥
ባሪያ በነገሠ ጊዜ፥ ሰነፍም እንጀራን በጠገበ ጊዜ፥
የተጠላች ሴት ቸር ባል ባገኘች ጊዜ፥
በምድር ላይ አራት ጥቃቅን ፍጥረቶች አሉ፤
ገብረ ጕንዳን ኀይል የሌላቸው ናቸው፥
ሽኮኮዎች ያልበረቱ ሕዝቦች ናቸው፥
አንበጣ ያለ መንግሥት ነው፥
እንሽላሊት በእጅ የሚሄድ ደካማ ሲሆን፥
መልካም አራማመድን የሚራመዱ ሦስት ፍጥረቶች አሉ፥
የአንበሳ ደቦል ከእንስሳ ሁሉ የሚበረታ፥
ክንፉን እያማታ በእንስቶች ዶሮዎች መካከል የሚሄድ አውራ ዶሮ፤
ራስህን ለቦዘኔነት ብትሰጥ፥
ወተትን እለብ ቅቤ ይሆንልሃል፥
የእኔ ነገር በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ተነገረ።
ልጄ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ምን እንደሆነ ዐውቀህ ተጠበቅ።
ኋላ እንዳትጸጸት ገንዘብህን፥ ልብህንና ጕልበትህን፥
ከምክር ጋር ሁሉን አድርግ፥
ወይንን በመጠጣት ጥበብን እንዳይዘነጓት
ለኀዘንተኞች ወይንን ስጧቸው፥
ኀዘናቸውን ይረሱ ዘንድ፥
አፍህን በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ክፈት፥
Open your mouth, and judge righteously; defend the cause of the poor and needy.
